# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: EL ENCLAVE SPECIALTY COFFEE ROASTERS

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters
- **Industry / Category**: Café & Specialty Coffee
- **Location**: Calle de Argumosa 89, Madrid, Madrid, Comunidad de Madrid, Spain
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Madrid.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.2 Stars across 255 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+34 91104 17 86)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Café & Specialty Coffee at its Finest in Madrid"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Madrid"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Calle de Argumosa 89, Madrid, Madrid
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 91104 17 86` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Calle de Argumosa 89, Madrid",
    "addressLocality": "Madrid",
    "addressRegion": "Comunidad de Madrid",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 91104 17 86",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).

- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.

---

   - Headline: "Experience Cafés & Specialty Coffee at its Finest in Madrid"

   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Madrid"

   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.

   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Calle de Espoz y Mina 68, Madrid, Madrid
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 91109 35 37` trigger for mobile visitors.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",

  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Calle de Espoz y Mina 68, Madrid",
    "addressLocality": "Madrid",
    "addressRegion": "Comunidad de Madrid",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 91109 35 37",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```

- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.

---

   - Headline: "Experience Barbers & Hair Salons at its Finest in Barcelona"

   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]

   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Carrer de la Diputació 140, Barcelona, Barcelona
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 93106 39 65` trigger for mobile visitors.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",

    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Carrer de la Diputació 140, Barcelona",
    "addressLocality": "Barcelona",
    "addressRegion": "Catalonia",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 93106 39 65",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```

- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

- **Business Name**: Sol & Sombra Traditional Barber Lounge

- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Barcelona.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - Sol & Sombra Traditional Barber Lounge logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+34 93111 57 16)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Barbers & Hair Salons at its Finest in Barcelona"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Barcelona"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Sol & Sombra Traditional Barber Lounge**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Carrer de Balmes 119, Barcelona, Barcelona
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 93111 57 16` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi Sol & Sombra Traditional Barber Lounge, I would like to inquire about...").

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Sol & Sombra Traditional Barber Lounge",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Carrer de Balmes 119, Barcelona",
    "addressLocality": "Barcelona",
    "addressRegion": "Catalonia",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 93111 57 16",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: Casa de Comidas Tierra Viva

- **Location**: Carrer de la Pau 72, Valencia, Valencia, Comunitat Valenciana, Spain
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Valencia.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.2 Stars across 208 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - Casa de Comidas Tierra Viva logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+34 96103 43 93)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Restaurants & Tapas at its Finest in Valencia"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Valencia"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Casa de Comidas Tierra Viva**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Carrer de la Pau 72, Valencia, Valencia
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 96103 43 93` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi Casa de Comidas Tierra Viva, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Casa de Comidas Tierra Viva",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Carrer de la Pau 72, Valencia",
    "addressLocality": "Valencia",
    "addressRegion": "Comunitat Valenciana",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 96103 43 93",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

- **Business Name**: Paloma Functional Fitness & Boxing

---

- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.

  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - Paloma Functional Fitness & Boxing logo / brand mark

   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+44 20 1019 607)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Independent Gyms & Fitness Studios at its Finest in London"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in London"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Paloma Functional Fitness & Boxing**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Oxford St 38, London, London
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+44 20 1019 607` trigger for mobile visitors.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Paloma Functional Fitness & Boxing",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Oxford St 38, London",
    "addressLocality": "London",
    "addressRegion": "Greater London",
    "addressCountry": "United Kingdom"
  },
  "telephone": "+44 20 1019 607",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: ESTUDIO DE PILATES & YOGA ESPACIO CENTRAL

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: Estudio de Pilates & Yoga Espacio Central
- **Industry / Category**: Independent Gyms & Fitness Studios
- **Location**: Upper St 123, London, London, Greater London, United Kingdom
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in London.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.2 Stars across 69 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - Estudio de Pilates & Yoga Espacio Central logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+44 20 1056 572)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Independent Gyms & Fitness Studios at its Finest in London"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in London"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Estudio de Pilates & Yoga Espacio Central**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Upper St 123, London, London
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+44 20 1056 572` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi Estudio de Pilates & Yoga Espacio Central, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Estudio de Pilates & Yoga Espacio Central",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Upper St 123, London",
    "addressLocality": "London",
    "addressRegion": "Greater London",
    "addressCountry": "United Kingdom"
  },
  "telephone": "+44 20 1056 572",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: SANTA CLARA FUNCTIONAL FITNESS & BOXING

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: Santa Clara Functional Fitness & Boxing
- **Industry / Category**: Independent Gyms & Fitness Studios
- **Location**: Shoreditch High St 102, London, London, Greater London, United Kingdom
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in London.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.2 Stars across 118 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - Santa Clara Functional Fitness & Boxing logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+44 20 1108 323)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Independent Gyms & Fitness Studios at its Finest in London"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in London"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Santa Clara Functional Fitness & Boxing**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Shoreditch High St 102, London, London
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+44 20 1108 323` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi Santa Clara Functional Fitness & Boxing, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Santa Clara Functional Fitness & Boxing",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Shoreditch High St 102, London",
    "addressLocality": "London",
    "addressRegion": "Greater London",
    "addressCountry": "United Kingdom"
  },
  "telephone": "+44 20 1108 323",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: EL ENCLAVE SPECIALTY COFFEE ROASTERS

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters
- **Industry / Category**: Café & Specialty Coffee
- **Location**: NW 2nd Ave (Wynwood) 89, Miami, Miami, Florida, United States
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Miami.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.2 Stars across 255 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+1 (305) 104-1786)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Café & Specialty Coffee at its Finest in Miami"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Miami"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: NW 2nd Ave (Wynwood) 89, Miami, Miami
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+1 (305) 104-1786` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "El Enclave Specialty Coffee Roasters",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "NW 2nd Ave (Wynwood) 89, Miami",
    "addressLocality": "Miami",
    "addressRegion": "Florida",
    "addressCountry": "United States"
  },
  "telephone": "+1 (305) 104-1786",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

   - Alborada Café de Barrio logo / brand mark

   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+1 (305) 109-3537)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Cafés & Specialty Coffee at its Finest in Miami"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Miami"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Alborada Café de Barrio**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Brickell Ave 68, Miami, Miami
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+1 (305) 109-3537` trigger for mobile visitors.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Alborada Café de Barrio",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Brickell Ave 68, Miami",
    "addressLocality": "Miami",
    "addressRegion": "Florida",
    "addressCountry": "United States"
  },
  "telephone": "+1 (305) 109-3537",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: MVP BARBER STUDIO

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: MVP Barber Studio
- **Industry / Category**: Barber shop
- **Location**: C. del Molino de Viento, 10, Centro, 28004 Madrid, Spain, Madrid, , 
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Madrid.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.9 Stars across 1054 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - MVP Barber Studio logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (635 70 81 12)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Barber shop at its Finest in Madrid"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.9/5 Stars by local clients in Madrid"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose MVP Barber Studio**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: C. del Molino de Viento, 10, Centro, 28004 Madrid, Spain, Madrid
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:635 70 81 12` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi MVP Barber Studio, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "MVP Barber Studio",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "C. del Molino de Viento, 10, Centro, 28004 Madrid, Spain",
    "addressLocality": "Madrid",
    "addressRegion": "",
    "addressCountry": ""
  },
  "telephone": "635 70 81 12",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

# COMPLETE WEBSITE BUILD SPECIFICATION: TOSTADURÍA ARTESANAL TIERRA VIVA

## 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW
- **Business Name**: Tostaduría Artesanal Tierra Viva
- **Industry / Category**: Cafés & Specialty Coffee
- **Location**: Calle de Hortaleza 72, Madrid, Madrid, Comunidad de Madrid, Spain
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Madrid.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.2 Stars across 208 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - Tostaduría Artesanal Tierra Viva logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+34 91103 43 93)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Cafés & Specialty Coffee at its Finest in Madrid"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Madrid"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose Tostaduría Artesanal Tierra Viva**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Calle de Hortaleza 72, Madrid, Madrid
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 91103 43 93` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi Tostaduría Artesanal Tierra Viva, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Tostaduría Artesanal Tierra Viva",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Calle de Hortaleza 72, Madrid",
    "addressLocality": "Madrid",
    "addressRegion": "Comunidad de Madrid",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 91103 43 93",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

- **Business Name**: La Bohemia Hair Studio & Grooming
- **Industry / Category**: Barbers & Hair Salons
- **Location**: Carrer d'Enric Granados 51, Barcelona, Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
- **Target Audience**: Local residents, discerning neighborhood clients, and mobile searchers in Barcelona.
- **Reputation Status**: 4.2 Stars across 257 customer reviews.
- **Core Value Proposition**: Premier artisanal craftsmanship, personal customer care, transparent service packages, and effortless mobile booking.
- **Service Package Tier**: Starting at €500 with optional €40/mo managed hosting and high-speed local CDN.

---

## 2. DESIGN PHILOSOPHY & VISUAL SYSTEM
- **Aesthetic**: Premium dark navy and charcoal interface with subtle electric-cyan accents and warm gold trust badges.
- **Palette**:
  - Primary Background: `#0b1120`
  - Card & Surface: `#111827`
  - Accent / Primary CTA: `#0284c7` (Electric Sky Blue)
  - Secondary Accent: `#06b6d4` (Cyan Glow)
  - Text Primary: `#f8fafc`
  - Text Muted: `#94a3b8`
  - Border Highlights: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`
- **Typography**:
  - Headings: Modern geometric sans-serif or refined modern serif (`Plus Jakarta Sans`, `Space Grotesk`, or `Playfair Display`).
  - Body: Crisp, highly legible sans-serif (`Inter`, 16px base, 1.6 line-height).
- **Component Styling**:
  - Border radius: `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, `rounded-xl` for inputs and buttons.
  - Micro-interactions: Subtle scale-up on hover (`hover:scale-[1.02]`), gentle glowing border transitions.
  - Backdrop blur: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/80`) for sticky navbar and modals.

---

## 3. PAGE STRUCTURE & SECTIONS

### Page 1: Home (Hero & Conversion Hub)
1. **Sticky Header**:
   - La Bohemia Hair Studio & Grooming logo / brand mark
   - Nav links: Services, About, Reviews, Location, FAQ
   - Action Button: "Book Now" + Direct Call icon (+34 93108 61 44)
2. **Hero Section**:
   - Headline: "Experience Barbers & Hair Salons at its Finest in Barcelona"
   - Subheadline: "Dedicated service, uncompromising quality, and warm neighborhood hospitality tailored to you."
   - Dual CTA Buttons: [Book Appointment / Request Quote] & [Chat on WhatsApp]
   - Trust Badge: "Rated 4.2/5 Stars by local clients in Barcelona"
3. **Featured Services Grid**:
   - 3 to 4 core service cards with icons, realistic pricing indications, time duration, and a "Select" button.
4. **Why Choose La Bohemia Hair Studio & Grooming**:
   - 3 value pillars: Artisanal expertise, transparent pricing, guaranteed customer satisfaction.
5. **Interactive Reviews Carousel**:
   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.
6. **Location, Map & Opening Hours**:
   - Address: Carrer d'Enric Granados 51, Barcelona, Barcelona
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips
7. **Lead Capture & Booking Modal / Form**:
   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

## 4. FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS & INTEGRATIONS
- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 93108 61 44` trigger for mobile visitors.
- **Direct WhatsApp Chat**: `https://wa.me/...` pre-filled message ("Hi La Bohemia Hair Studio & Grooming, I would like to inquire about...").
- **LocalBusiness Schema (JSON-LD)**:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "La Bohemia Hair Studio & Grooming",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Carrer d'Enric Granados 51, Barcelona",
    "addressLocality": "Barcelona",
    "addressRegion": "Catalonia",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 93108 61 44",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.

   - Authentic customer quotes highlighting craft, punctuality, and friendly atmosphere.

   - Address: Carrer de Mallorca 102, Barcelona, Barcelona
   - Interactive OpenStreetMap/Google Maps embed
   - Weekly opening hours table with live "Open Now / Closed" indicator
   - Transit and parking tips

   - Frictionless 3-step booking inquiry: Select Service -> Choose Date/Time -> Contact Details.

---

- **Click-to-Call**: Immediate `tel:+34 93110 83 23` trigger for mobile visitors.

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "Santa Clara Hair Studio & Grooming",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "Carrer de Mallorca 102, Barcelona",
    "addressLocality": "Barcelona",
    "addressRegion": "Catalonia",
    "addressCountry": "Spain"
  },
  "telephone": "+34 93110 83 23",
  "priceRange": "€€"
}
```
- **Mobile Sticky CTA Bar**: On mobile viewports (`<768px`), fixed bottom bar with [Call Now] and [Book Appointment] buttons.
- **Fast Load Performance**: 0 render-blocking assets, responsive `srcset` images, accessible ARIA attributes.
